## License summary

The standard license permits lifetime use across unlimited personal/commercial projects, including sold games, without royalties or mandatory credit. Recordings remain copyrighted by their owners. Distribute sounds only within permitted productions, not as a standalone library; do not share or sublicense raw files. Sole-editor use applies unless a multi-user license is obtained. Raw-library storage is limited to one local drive and one backup, with no network/server uploads. AI training/development is prohibited. These rights depend on compliance and proof of purchase; the linked full license controls.

## Project handling

The full library stays in the purchased ZIP outside the Godot project. Selected `audio/` files and their Godot sidecars are excluded from Git to avoid uploading licensed recordings. Godot import caches are also ignored. The root `ATTRIBUTION.md` entry is an internal provenance record, not a claim that public credit is compulsory.

The receipt contains personal/payment-contact details and is intentionally absent from the repository. Its private copy and the paid amount are recorded in `/HardDrive/Obsidian/hermes/mygame/assets/purchases.md`.

No license document was included in the supplied ZIP. The license clauses above were verified through indexed excerpts of Sonniss's official page. Direct snapshot download returned HTTP 403, so no full-license snapshot is stored.
